descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Toon Shooter is a bright, fast arcade shooter built for VR. You hold the fort - a sandbag bunker overlooking a colourful container yard - while waves of toon troopers push in from cover to cover.

DUCK, DODGE, SHOOT BACK
Enemies pop up from behind sandbags, crates and dumpsters and fire slow glowing rounds you can actually see coming. Duck behind your wall for real, lean out of the way, or shoot their rounds right out of the air for bonus points.

8 GUNS ON ONE WHEEL
Pistol, revolver, SMG, assault rifle, shotgun, sniper, grenade launcher and rocket launcher - swap any time from the weapon wheel. Throw real grenades with your other hand.

BOOM
Exploding barrels and gas tanks sit beside every cover. Hit one and everyone crouched behind it goes up in a burst of toon confetti. Chain them for big combos.

BOSS TANK
Wave 5 and wave 10 roll a toon tank through the back gate. Rockets and grenades hurt it most.

8 MAPS
The Yard, Sunset Yard, Snow Base, Desert Outpost, Junkyard, Toxic Zone, Candy Yard and Neon Dusk - each with its own sky, colours and weather.

SCORE CHASE
Kill fast to build a combo up to x5, clear a wave without getting hit for a Perfect bonus, and beat your best score on every map. No blood - troopers pop into confetti.

Developed and published by Citiview Studios.
